Tom — thanks for the note and the deadline. Looping in Monica (Security Compliance) and Karthik (Platform/Infra) so they can provide the formal statements and the remediation export.

High level we can share immediately:
- Authenticated host scans: weekly (agent-based, authenticated, rule set mapped to OWASP/industry benchmarks)
- Network & container image scans: monthly (with out-of-band scans triggered for new images)
- Continuous CVE monitoring with automated alerting for published advisories

SLA commitments we typically state for customer materials:
- Critical (P0/P1): aim to patch or mitigate within 7 calendar days from confirmed reproducible exploit or published exploit in the wild
- High: 30 calendar days (exceptions tracked and escalated)
- Medium: 90 calendar days (risk-accepted cases documented)

I'll get you a formal evidence packet (policy PDF + remediation export) by EOD Friday 2026-12-04. Monica — can you confirm these SLAs in a signed attestation and point to the remediation export location? Karthik — can you prepare the last 90-day CVE export filtered by Acme tenant identifiers?

Subject: Vulnerability Management statement and remediation evidence (Redwood)

Hi Tom / Acme team —

Please find the formal summary below and the attached evidence bundle (vm-evidence-packet.zip) which includes: the VM policy (vm-policy.pdf), a 90-day remediation export (cve-log-2026Q4.csv), and scan schedule logs. If you need a CSV column mapping, let me know and I can include it.

Summary of controls and commitments (for SIG / SOC 2 reference):

1) Scan cadence
- Authenticated host scans: weekly via our managed agent; coverage target 95% of customer-managed hosts in Dedicated and Private deployments, 85% for hosted multi-tenant where agent installation is optional.
- Container image scanning: on-build and registry-scan nightly; full registry sweep monthly.
- Network/External scans: monthly external-facing scan; immediate ad-hoc scans triggered for infrastructure changes or reported vulnerabilities.

2) Triage process & evidence
- All findings are triaged by severity using CWE/CVSS v3.1 and our internal risk matrix. Events open a ticket in our remediation queue; P1/P0 tickets auto-page on-call until acknowledgement. The attached cve-log includes ticket IDs and remediation status for the past 90 days.

3) Customer-facing SLA guidance (as stated in our SOC 2/SIG materials)
- Critical (Exploit in the wild / RCE / immediate data exfil risk): initial mitigation or compensating control within 72 hours; patch or permanent remediation within 7 calendar days where vendor patch is available.
- High (high-confidence exploit or privilege escalation): remediation deployed or documented mitigation within 30 calendar days.
- Medium/Low: remediation within 90 calendar days or documented risk acceptance.

Notes and exceptions:
- SLA windows are measured from confirmed reproducible report and validated impact to the customer environment. For third-party managed dependencies (upstream vendor patches), timelines may reflect vendor availability; we provide compensating controls and workarounds until vendor fixes are deployed.
- Hosted customers can opt into accelerated remediation commit windows via Dedicated support add-ons; details are in the attached policy.

Evidence locations and exports:
- Evidence bundle attached to this thread (vm-evidence-packet.zip).
- Long-term audit logs for signed attestations are available in our secure Drive link (shared above) and via DocuSign where required.

If Acme needs a signed attestation document for procurement, I can attach a signed PDF. Jordan — I’ve included a signed attestation draft as "signed-cve-attestation.pdf" in the evidence package; please confirm if Acme needs the attestation on DocuSign.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Head of Security Compliance, Redwood Inference
